title: Wardrobe

options.name: The design
options.text: A two-door wardrobe made to fit the space, with flat doors, a shelf at the top, a hanging rail under it and a low shelf for shoes and boxes.

poster.alt: 3D model of a two-door wardrobe with flat doors, a top shelf, a hanging rail and a low shelf

notes: Width, height and depth are the measured sizes of the space.
The inside layout (top shelf, rail and low shelf) and the plinth height are standard sizes for now and can be changed.
Handles are not shown yet: tell me if you would like knobs, bar handles or push to open doors.
Colours on screen are a guide.
